ns2:course.label: Resident Internship
ns2:course.description: Supervised, on-campus, learning experience with faculty engaged in research. Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of academic advisor or Department Internship Coordinator.
